blocks.text: DAVAO CITY — A female juvenile Philippine eagle (𝘗𝘪𝘵𝘩𝘦𝘤𝘰𝘱𝘩𝘢𝘨𝘢 𝘫𝘦𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳𝘺𝘪) was electrocuted in Sitio Panghaon, Barangay Guinalaban of Salay town, Misamis Oriental on Wednesday morning. The Department of Environment and Natural Resources in Northern Mindanao through the Community Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO) Gingoog City is now investigating the death of a Philippine eagle found near an electrical post in Sitio Panghaon, Barangay Guinalaban, Salay, Misamis Oriental. According to the agency’s Facebook page on Saturday, CENRO Gingoog City received a report from barangay officials on Wednesday morning that a farmer in the area discovered the eagle at around 9 a.m. […]...
